messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 alert for aurum-prod-dedpool - node gpu-node-usw2-17 reported GPU ECC multi-bit errors and immediate eviction of pods. Affected tenant: aurum-vpc-23. Pager: maria (oncall).

maria (sre): I'm on it. Confirming impact window and if any jobs still running. tagging @dave @ryan.

dave (eng-runtime): Noted. Could be NVLink error cascade. Check kernel logs and nvml output. If node is unstable, recommend drain + replace.

maria (sre): pulling logs now. run: `ssh ded-node-usw2-17 'journalctl -u nvml -n50'`

maria (sre): log snippet ->
```
Mar 22 01:14:02 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, tpc 00000028 m 0 00000000
Mar 22 01:14:02 nvidia: ECC multi-bit error on GPU0
Mar 22 01:14:03 kubelet: Evicting pods due to GPU health degraded
```

maria (sre): Node is actively evicting. Some aurum jobs restarted but we saw 6 in-flight requests fail (latency spikes observed in metrics).

ryan (dedicated-ops): Checking pool capacity. aurum-prod-dedpool has 12 nodes, 2 reserved for burst. With this node out, we drop under committed SLA for sustained 90th percentile throughput if we lose another. We should move non-critical jobs to the shared-reserve pool and free up capacity.

sean (support): Customer-facing impact: Aurum CS ticket #AUR-972: customers saw 502s on inference calls for ~90s. Liam, can you draft a quick DM to the Aurum account team? They asked for realtime updates in private channel.

liam (cs): drafting message now. Will CC legal/enterprise-ops. Proposed: "We are observing degraded inference throughput affecting some calls. We are replacing the affected GPU node and routing traffic to fallback capacity. ETA ~20-30m. Will update with mitigation and RCA." OK?

maria (sre): mitigation plan I'm executing: 1) cordon + drain node safely 2) ensure tenant isolation for aurum-vpc-23 so only their pods moved to reserved nodes 3) kick off replacement from pool spare 4) if replacement delayed >15m, do routing rule to fall back to hosted API for critical requests.

ryan (dedicated-ops): commands I'll run now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-usw2-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-usw2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --pod-selector='tenant=aurum-vpc-23' --timeout=10m
```

maria (sre): Note: use pod-selector to avoid moving other tenants off the pool — keep isolation. If drain blocks on long-running jobs, use `evict` with grace period override after approval.

ryan (dedicated-ops): starting drain.

incident-bot: autoupdate: runbook:dedicated-gpu-hardware -> https://ops.redwood.example/runbooks/dedicated-gpu-hw (view-only link)

dave (eng-runtime): While drain is in progress, I'll enable fallback route for aurum-vpc-23 to use the compatible Llama-3-70B-quant variant on hosted for low-latency critical traffic. Config change in the routing service: set route weight 80% hosted-fallback, 20% local.

maria (sre): please add a header to responses for correlation: `x-rw-fallback: hosted` so we can track errors post-failover.

ryan (dedicated-ops): drain progress: 4/6 pods evacuated for aurum tenant, 2 in terminated state waiting on checkpoint-copy. One job is a long-running batch (checkpointing). Requesting permission to force-evict after 2m if not completing.

maria (sre): force-evict approved. Use `kubectl delete pod --grace-period=30 --force` and log pod ids. Note risk: in-flight requests will fail; that's why we already set hosted fallback.

ryan (dedicated-ops): forced eviction done. Node marked drained. Triggering instance replacement via infra API: `infractl replace-node --id gpu-node-usw2-17 --pool aurum-prod-dedpool`

hardware-oncall: Received replacement request. Opening cloud ticket with provider for host replacement and shipping diagnostics. If hardware is in warranty, swap will be automated; if preemptible, provider may not replace. I'll follow-up.

maria (sre): health checks: traffic rerouted, error budget consumed ~0.3% for aurum route, 502 spike mitigated after fallback. Observability: APM traces show fallback path added tag x-rw-fallback.

sean (support): Notifying Aurum in private channel now: "Mitigation in progress: we drained the affected node and routed critical traffic to fallback; replacement in flight. No data exfiltration, tenant isolation maintained. ETA 20-45m for full restore."

liam (cs): Aurum replied: "Thanks — please confirm once the node is replaced and if there will be any additional throttling on our end." They're asking about throttling.

maria (sre): We'll avoid throttling by prioritizing their critical routes to hosted until node replaced. Non-critical batch jobs might be delayed.

dave (eng-runtime): Quick note: schedule a canary traffic shift back only after we validate nvml reports and kernel logs post-replace. Also run model checksum to ensure quantization cache didn't get corrupted.

incident-bot: New note added to incident: incident-summaries/1966123456 -> https://incidents.redwood.example/1966123456

hardware-oncall: Provider flagged a potential PCIe fabric fault on the host. Replacement initiated; ETA 28m. I'll attach hardware logs when available.

maria (sre): tagging @oncall-night for handoff at 02:00 UTC. Current state: node drained, traffic fallback in place, replacement in progress, customer notified. If replacement completes before handoff, I'll follow up and close. Otherwise please continue monitoring and own ticket with provider.

oncall-night: acknowledged. taking handoff at 02:00 UTC. Will run post-replace verification checklist:
```
- confirm node back in pool and kubelet healthy
- nvml reports no ECC errors for 30m
- run perf-smoke on sample prompts (p95 < 200ms)
- remove hosted fallback and monitor errors
```

maria (sre): final note before handoff: capture all pod eviction IDs, commands run, forced-evict justification, and customer DMs in incident page. Recording timeline for RCA.

ryan (dedicated-ops): replacement completed at 1966123560. New node id gpu-node-usw2-54 joined pool. Kube labels applied.

dave (eng-runtime): running smoke checks. model-load OK, cache warmup in progress. No ECCs reported in nvml.

oncall-night: verified p95 under threshold, removing hosted fallback now. Observability: no increased error rate for aurum route after 10m.

liam (cs): update sent to Aurum: full service restored, no further action required on their side. They asked for the RCA ETA.

maria (sre): RCA ETA set to EOD today. Root cause seems to be sudden multi-bit ECC on GPU (possible hardware degradation). Hardware team to confirm. Closing operational thread; incident page will track postmortem.

oncall-night: closing thread here, will escalate to postmortem if hardware confirms permanent degradation. :white_check_mark:
